templatePrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. One complete Northbound playing card face, edge-to-edge in the portrait aspect ratio of the APPROVED REFERENCE CARD. The reference is the visual template only. Match exact layout, distances and thicknesses as closely as possible: simple dark slate iron frame, shallow parchment band with very large rank on left, suit title centered, one standard suit glyph right, central painting, tiny NORTHBOUND footer. Change the illustration and the upper band labels and glyph. Art direction DODEKATHLOS Northbound: original hand-painted stylized 2D military-mythic Greek world seen by a Viking, broad matte brush-painted angular masses, ink contour, just two to three shadow values, subtle fierce expression, expressive anatomy, no photographic or engraved detail. Main creature almost fills the panel width, entire body and extremities in the image, good scale and clear head and silhouette. Strong subject/background separation everywhere: creature brighter and more saturated, warm or pale rim light on creature only, background low contrast deep muted navy with one quiet silhouette of Greek column or stones, no atmospheric foreground over subject. Similar subject-to-background separation to reference. Keep the main creature and scene recognizably new; do not retain any creature anatomy from reference. No outside margin, card mockup, second card, captions, or additional text.
